ops.body: Fixed by the v0.21.0 cut. Gate spot-checked: adopt.go:56-62 — gateWrapper is `printf r >&3; exec 3>&-; if ! IFS= read -r marker <&4 || [ "$marker" != start ]; then exit 125; fi; exec 4<&-; exec "$@"` — a single conditional read exiting 125 on EOF or a wrong marker, and no `trap` appears anywhere in adopt.go, so SIGTERM reaches the parked shell normally. Both halves of the bug (busy-spin on EOF, TERM immunity) are structurally gone.
